subject: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell
messages:
From: Lauren Park <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell

Hi team,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. To keep the marketplace onboarding on schedule we need two items from Redwood by Friday:

1) Final hero blurb and 2–3 supporting bullets showing key value props for the product page (we want something succinct for the tiles and hero).
2) SKU mapping / availability table so we can wire-up entitlements and private offers (list of SKUs, trial entitlements, and region availability).

Separately, pls call out any co-sell language you want in the hero (e.g., "Contact sales for co-sell assistance" vs. a direct CTA). Our partner team will surface buyer path recommendations based on that.

Cc'ing Ben Hart from Acme Procurement who asked for a copy for review.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Park
AWS Marketplace Program Manager
aws-marketplace@amazon.com

--
Attachment: onboarding_checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Park <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Hart <ben.hart@acme.io>
Date: 2026-10-27T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell

Hi Lauren — attaching a first-pass doc and the SKU mapping CSV for your team to ingest. Draft hero copy below and in the attachment (redwood_aws_listing_v1.docx).

Proposed hero (short):
Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.

Supporting bullets (short):
- Low-latency GPU inference with autoscaling and fallback policies.
- Cost controls: intelligent batching, KV caching, and quantization profiles.
- Enterprise-ready: VPC/private deploys, KMS integration, and audit logs.

Co-sell CTA: we propose a two-line subhead on the product page — "Work with our partner team for co-sell opportunities and private offers" with a button that opens a short contact form.

SKU notes (summary):
- sku_basic_us: hosted API (trial 14 days) — available us-east-1/us-west-2
- sku_dedicated_us: dedicated capacity (no trial) — available us-east-1
- sku_private_apac: private deployment (on-prem/VPC) — region-gated (contact sales)

Questions for you:
- Do you want the hero to include the phrase "co-sell" explicitly or use buyer-facing wording (e.g., "Contact sales")?
- Any formatting constraints for the hero subtitle (character counts)?

Thanks — attaching the two files.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships (Product)
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood_aws_listing_v1.docx; sku_mapping_sheet.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Park <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Hart <ben.hart@acme.io>
Date: 2026-10-27T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell

Nice start — quick copy nits and a security note.

Copy edits (inline):
- Hero short: swap "predictable, production-grade" -> "production-grade, cost-efficient" (emphasize unit economics for marketplace buyers).
- Bullet 2: add "(reduces per-token spend)" after batching.
- Bullet 3: change "KMS integration" -> "customer-managed KMS" to be explicit.

Security ask: Acme's procurement has asked for a short evidence summary on data residency and audit logs. I attached an outline we can use to build the evidence binder. Once Lauren confirms the hero language, I'll draft the one-pager evidence summary for the listing and attach to the page as a downloadable "Security & Compliance" PDF.

Forwarding Karthik's draft below for context.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: evidence_binder_outline.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Park <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Ben Hart <ben.hart@acme.io>
Date: 2026-10-27T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell

Love the edits, Kim. A couple of co-sell-focused asks to make the page sales-ready:

1) Add a short "Why partner with Redwood" paragraph (2–3 lines) under the bullets highlighting integration support + field enablement.
2) Add a prominent "Request co-sell" checkbox on the contact form that sets a HubSpot lead flag (so partner ops can route).
3) For PrivateOffer SKUs, put a note: "PrivateOffer enrollment requires a short qualification call; contact partner@redwood.ai".

I'll pull together the one-paragraph sales snippet and a short buyer objection list (pricing, latency SLAs, data residency) and drop into the drive link below by EOD. If Ben (Acme) has any procurement constraints, appreciate a quick note back.

-M
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Partnerships & Enablement, Redwood Inference
--
Quoted: "On 2026-10-27 at 11:02 AM, Karthik Iyer wrote: "Proposed hero (short): Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM inference...""

From: Lauren Park <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Hart <ben.hart@acme.io>
Date: 2026-10-28T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: hero availability language + SKU matrix for co-sell

Thanks all — this is great. Quick answers and next steps:

- Character limits: hero title 90 chars, subtitle 220 chars. The suggested copy fits after Kim's edits.
- "Co-sell" vs "Contact sales": we prefer buyer-facing wording on the page ("Contact sales for purchasing and partner assistance") and a separate partner-facing badge behind the scenes that we'll use for co-sell routing.
- Evidence: yes, please add the "Security & Compliance" one-pager. We'll link it as an attachment on the product page.
- SKU ingestion: I've looped in our onboarding engineer (cc'd in a separate thread) to pull the CSV; please ensure the sku_mapping_sheet.csv rows include entitlement flags (trial:true/false).

Ben — appreciate if you can confirm Acme's preferred regions for trial (us-east-1 / us-west-2) so we can toggle trial availability.

Next steps: Redwood to submit final doc + edited hero copy and completed SKU CSV by EOD Friday; AWS to ingest and send back listing preview next week.

Lauren Park
AWS Marketplace Program Manager
--
